english_classification.chapter_note: A highly systematic substrate teaching about cosmic pre-ordination/foreknowledge of the light. Seven moments follow a uniform pattern: 'Before [condition], [cosmic agent] was [prepared].' The structure is self-evidently complete and architectonic. Only ¶1 (dialogue frame) and ¶5 (editorial bridge inserting 'the sects' into the cosmic pattern) fall outside the oldest layer. Teaching purity is very high (0.913). The moderate institutional drift in the second half is minimal, concentrated in ¶5. The chapter preserves a remarkably intact substrate teaching about emanation sequence and cosmic determinism.
